plan.title: GPS Showroom Drives & Visit Logs
plan.description: Tesla GPS + Fleet Telemetry stages showroom visit logs, discovers unregistered showrooms, and drives multi-waypoint navigation. Multi-visit history, HITL discovery queue, dedicated Visit Logs workspace. See docs/0022_gps_showroom_drives/{PRD,UX,PROMPT}.md.

legend.note: Rows mirror the D1 plan_tasks columns so this file and /admin/plans/0022_gps_showroom_drives stay in sync. Insert idempotently on (plan_slug, task_key).

tasks.title: Shift-state transition detection (park/drive)
tasks.description: Persist last shift-state per VIN in CACHE (tesla:last-shift:<vin>); run heavy pipeline only on ...->P (park) and P->D (drive-away) transitions, not every 500ms frame. Webhook drive_state feeds same comparator; dedupe via CACHE. PRD 6.2.

tasks.title: Decision 1.a: home/work -> pause drives
tasks.description: Park within home/work radius -> set all active drives paused; halt processing.

tasks.title: Decision 1.b: active-stop match -> SOFT_ARRIVAL
tasks.description: Park near active-drive stop -> visit_log TESLA_SOFT_ARRIVAL/TESLA_STAGED, check stop off, flag pending.

tasks.title: Decision 1.c: any-showroom match -> SOFT_ARRIVAL
tasks.description: Park near any registered showroom (other drive/directory) -> visit_log SOFT_ARRIVAL.

tasks.title: Drive-away -> TESLA_STAGED follow-up (two-row)
tasks.description: On motion resume after a soft arrival, insert TESLA_STAGED row w/ arrival+departure+soft_arrival_id.

tasks.title: Drive viewport: active toggle + record-visit slide-over
tasks.description: Driving-this-list Switch; mark-visited opens VisitLogEditor slide-over (prefill staged); never block check-off.
